translation: Wind warmth (fengwen) is contraction of wind in spring, when the qi is already warm.
The Classic says, "In spring the qi has its disease in the head," so one treats the upper burner. The lung occupies the highest position, so the pathogen must injure it first.
This is disease first arising in the qi aspect of the Hand Great Yin (lung). If treatment is missed, it enters the Hand Reverting Yin pericardium, and the blood aspect is also injured.
